answer: **11,896 CHIP variant calls remain after removing reference calls from the dataset** (7,303 heterozygous + 4,593 homozygous variant calls across the 86 per-sample spreadsheets). As context, these 11,896 sample-level calls correspond to **673 unique (Chr:Pos, Ref/Alt) variants** (uniqueness keyed on position+alleles, not the largely-missing Variant ID column). The dataset contained 57,258 rows total: 44,211 Reference rows were removed and 1,151 NaN-Zygosity rows were excluded as no-calls.
